American Express (AXP) partnered with Airbnb so eligible luxury stays booked via Amex Travel count toward Platinum lodging credits; Graphite Card shows strong early adoption and stable delinquencies.
American Express (AXP) plans AI-driven product development and partnerships, including with OpenAI, to boost personalized, proactive cardholder experiences and deepen customer engagement.
